lines.en: label halloween2:
scene nightsky
: Costumes, huh?
lines.zh: : 装扮啊？

lines.en: : I wonder what everyone is going to dress up as?
lines.zh: : 不知道大家都会扮成什么呢？

lines.en: My head hits the pillow and my eyes navigate to the small crack in my window, focusing in on the only sliver of the night sky that I’m able to see from inside of my room.
lines.zh: 我的头陷进枕头，视线飘向窗户上那道小裂缝，聚焦在从房间里唯一能看见的那一线夜空上。

lines.en: I never particularly cared for Halloween until roughly half an hour ago when I realized it won’t just be another excuse for people to get drunk and wander the streets anymore.
lines.zh: 我从来没特别喜欢过万圣节——直到大约半小时前，我才意识到它不再只是人们喝醉后在街上游荡的又一个借口了。

lines.en: This year, I’m going to be spending my time with a bunch of [teenager]s who will, hopefully, be attempting to seduce me or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 今年，我要和一群[teenager]一起度过，而她们大概会试图勾引我，或者类似的事情。

lines.en: Kind of like how the beach trip went, I guess.
lines.zh: 大概就跟那次海滩旅行差不多吧。

lines.en: Sure, the beach didn’t exactly end in the most ideal way for everyone involved (Sorry, Rin), but what could possibly go wrong at a Halloween party?
lines.zh: 当然，海滩那次对每个参与者来说结局都不算太理想（抱歉了，Rin），但一场万圣节派对又能出什么乱子呢？

lines.en: Especially one at the coveted Amamiya mansion, which I’ll finally be seeing for the first time.
lines.zh: 尤其是在那座令人向往的 Amamiya 宅邸里办的派对——我终于要第一次见到了。

lines.en: That does come with its own list of setbacks, however.
lines.zh: 不过这也有它自己的一长串麻烦。

lines.en: Knowing that Ayane’s father and butler live there, I don’t know if I’ll be able to have as much...alone time with anyone as I’d like.
lines.zh: 考虑到 Ayane 的父亲和管家都住在那里，我不确定自己能不能如愿和谁拥有足够的……独处时间。

lines.en: But it’s a mansion, right? I’m sure there’s some...hidden bookcase-door or something that I can disappear into with someone if I really want.
lines.zh: 但那可是豪宅，对吧？我肯定会有某个……隐藏的书架门之类的东西，只要我真想，就能带着谁消失进去。

lines.en: scene black
I close my eyes and think of the many horrible things that are bound to happen over the next two days, trying to drown them out with thoughts of scantily dressed girls.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，想着接下来两天注定会发生的许多可怕事情，试图用衣着暴露的女孩们的念头把它们淹没。

lines.en: It’s only a matter of time until I start getting roped into more uncomfortable conversations where I need to conceal my relationships with pretty much everyone in the class inside of one confined space.
lines.zh: 迟早我会被卷进更多令人不适的对话——在那么一个封闭空间里，我得把我和班上几乎所有人的关系都藏起来。

lines.en: It’s actually kind of nerve-wracking when I put it that way.
lines.zh: 这么说起来的话，其实还挺让人紧张的。

lines.en: But if there’s anything I can be associated with, it’s danger.
lines.zh: 不过如果我跟什么东西沾得上边的话，那就是危险。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开个玩笑。

lines.en: I’m not really an exciting person.
lines.zh: 我其实不是个有意思的人。

lines.en: But you already know that.
lines.zh: 不过你已经知道了。

lines.en: Either way, I’m suddenly looking forward to the next couple days.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我突然开始期待接下来的几天了。

lines.en: Unfortunately, it looks like it’s going to start with a large hit to my wallet.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，看起来开头就是钱包大出血。

lines.en: $ totaldays += 1
$ day = 6
[totaldays] Days have passed...
lines.zh: [totaldays] 天过去了……

lines.en: Roughly twelve hours and forty-three minutes later...
lines.zh: 大约十二小时四十三分钟后……

lines.en: scene halloweenmall1
Just as planned last night, Ayane and Sana show up at the house first thing in the morning and I am forcefully dragged out of bed and into the chaperone position.
lines.zh: 正如昨晚计划的那样，Ayane 和 Sana 一大早就出现在我家门口，我被硬生生地从床上拖了起来，塞进了监护人这个位置。

lines.en: As soon as we get to the mall, the girls make a beeline to a familiar clothing store that...apparently also sells Halloween stuff?
lines.zh: 我们一到商场，女孩们就直奔一家熟悉的服装店——那家店……好像也卖万圣节的东西？

lines.en: Or at least, that’s what I expected when they came here first.
lines.zh: 至少，她们一进来就先往这儿走的时候，我是这么以为的。

lines.en: Actually looking around, I don’t see anything out of the ordinary whatsoever.
lines.zh: 可真四处看了看，我根本没发现任何不寻常的东西。

lines.en: : Ami, why are we here? Isn’t there an actual costume shop at the mall?
lines.zh: : Ami，我们为什么在这儿？商场里不是有专门的变装店吗？

lines.en: : Well...yeah.
: But you seemed worried about spending too much money yesterday, so I’m probably just going to buy a few small accessories here and kind of...
lines.zh: : 但你昨天好像很担心花太多钱，所以我大概就在这儿买点小配件，然后……

lines.en: : I don’t know, throw something together maybe?
lines.zh: : 我也说不好，也许随便拼凑一下？

lines.en: : You’re going to make your own costume?
lines.zh: : 你要自己做装扮？

lines.en: : Isn’t Halloween tomorrow? That seems kind of rushed.
lines.zh: : 万圣节不就是明天吗？这也太赶了吧。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall2
: Yeah, but I don’t want to bother you when you already let me live there for free and stuff...
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你已经免费让我住在那儿了什么的，我不想再麻烦你……

lines.en: : I’m your legal guardian. I think at least that much is expected of me.
lines.zh: : 我是你的法定监护人。我觉得至少这点是我该做的。

lines.en: : It’s fine, really. I make costumes with Molly and stuff all the time.
lines.zh: : 真的没关系。我经常和 Molly 一起做装扮什么的。

lines.en: : If I really can’t throw anything together on time, I can just have her help me. She's pretty amazing when it comes to that stuff.
lines.zh: : 如果真赶不出来，我让她帮我就行了。她在这方面相当厉害。

lines.en: : I’ll probably just wind up being an anime character or something anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我最后大概还是会扮成某个动画角色之类的。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure the Halloween shop doesn’t carry those because of copyright stuff.
lines.zh: : 而且我很确定万圣节商店不会卖那些，因为有版权的问题。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall3
: Heya! You guys are up early today!
lines.zh: : 嗨呀！你们今天起得真早！

lines.en: Chika suddenly shows up, which I guess was bound to happen on account of her working here, and wastes no time in pointing out that...yes, it is very early.
lines.zh: Chika 突然出现了——考虑到她就在这儿上班，这也算是意料之中的事——而且她一刻也没浪费，立刻指出……是的，现在真的很早。

lines.en: : Halloween shopping.
lines.zh: : 万圣节采购。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall4
: Here? Strange choice.
lines.zh: : 在这儿？选择真奇怪。

lines.en: : You know there’s a-
lines.zh: : 你们知道那边有家——

lines.en: scene halloweenmall5
: We know. I just need a few accessories and stuff. I'm making my own costume this year.
lines.zh: : 我们知道。我只是需要一些配件什么的。今年我要自己做装扮。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall6
: Oh, awesome! Is this for the thing at Ayane’s place?
lines.zh: : 哦，好厉害！这是为了 Ayane 家那场活动吗？

lines.en: : Mhm~ Were you coming too, Chika?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼~ Chika 你也会来吗？

lines.en: : You know it. I already bought my costume and stuff, but I’m still trying to figure out a way to get Yumi to come as well.
lines.zh: : 那当然。我的装扮什么的已经买好了，但我还在想办法让 Yumi 也来。

lines.en: : You could always just...not do that instead.
lines.zh: : 你也可以……干脆别这么做啊。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall7
: Don’t be mean. She’s not even here to defend herself.
lines.zh: : 别这么刻薄。她又不在这儿，没法为自己辩解。

lines.en: : Heh...Well...at least I don’t have to worry about Yumi stealing you, apparently...
lines.zh: : 嘿……嗯……至少我看来不用担心 Yumi 会把你抢走了……

lines.en: : You know Yumi’s birthday is on Halloween, right? I can’t just not include her.
lines.zh: : 你知道 Yumi 的生日就在万圣节那天吧？我总不能把她排除在外。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how depressing it is to be alone on your birthday AND Halloween at once? That's like, mega-depressing.
lines.zh: : 你知道生日和万圣节撞在同一天、还要一个人过，有多惨吗？那简直是超级加倍惨。

lines.en: : It’s not depressing if she has Chinami. Just put those two together again.
lines.zh: : 她有 Chinami 的话就不惨了。把那两个再凑一对不就行了。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall8
: See, the thing is that Chinami’s never really experienced Halloween before, so it would be just another day for her.
lines.zh: : 问题是，Chinami 从来没有真正过过万圣节，所以对她来说那也只是普通的一天。

lines.en: : To be fair, she gets her own personal Halloween every time she comes to the mall.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，她每次来商场，都像是过了一场专属于她的万圣节。

lines.en: : Is that a dog-mask joke?
lines.zh: : 这是在拿狗面具开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s a dog-mask joke.
lines.zh: : 对，就是在拿狗面具开玩笑。

lines.en: : Can we, umm...not talk about the dog mask? I’m still a little shocked after seeing my [uncle] walking around holding hands with a small girl dressed as a dog.
lines.zh: : 我们能不能，嗯……别聊狗面具了？看到我[uncle]牵着一个打扮成狗的小女孩到处走，我到现在还有点缓不过来。

lines.en: : Not really a thing I ever wanted to see.
lines.zh: : 那真不是我此生想看到的东西。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall9
: You guys...held hands?
lines.zh: : 你们……牵手了？

lines.en: You know, now that I think about it, that part probably wasn’t necessary and I’m sure it sounds weird to hear out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 现在想想，那部分大概没什么必要，而且冷不丁听上去肯定很怪。

lines.en: : I probably shouldn’t have done that, should I?
lines.zh: : 我大概不该那么做的，对吧？

lines.en: scene halloweenmall10
: Yeah, you really shouldn’t have. It was weird.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你真不该那么做。很怪。

lines.en: : Nononono! It’s totally fine! I’m just surprised she let you hold her hand in the first place!
lines.zh: : 不不不不！完全没问题！我只是很惊讶她居然会让你牵她的手！

lines.en: : She’s normally super careful about touching people she’s not familiar with.
lines.zh: : 她平时对碰不熟悉的人可小心了。

lines.en: : Sensei, why is a girl that small so familiar with you?
lines.zh: : Sensei，为什么那么小的一个女孩跟你这么熟？

lines.en: : Ami, don’t you need to be shopping right now?
lines.zh: : Ami，你现在不是该去买东西吗？

lines.en: : Sana and Ayane have just been browsing since we walked in and I’m pretty sure they’re waiting for you to finish.
lines.zh: : Sana 和 Ayane 从我们进来就一直在随便看看，我敢肯定她们在等你弄完。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall11
: R-Right! You still need to buy stuff!
lines.zh: : 对——对！你还得买东西呢！

lines.en: : Sorry. I don’t normally get visitors this early so I got a little wrapped up in chatting.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我平时这么早不会有客人来，所以一聊起来就收不住了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Sensei was just leaving anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Sensei 反正也正要走。

lines.en: : I was?
lines.zh: : 我要走了吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. Right after you give me your credit card.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。等你把信用卡给我之后。

lines.en: : Who do you think you’re talking to, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你以为你在跟谁说话呢，Ami？

lines.en: : A loser.
lines.zh: : 一个废物。

lines.en: : Card, please.
lines.zh: : 卡，给我。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and pull my credit card out of my wallet, handing it over to Ami as I am incredibly weak to her for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，从钱包里抽出信用卡递给 Ami——出于某种我无法理解的原因，我对她就是完全没有抵抗力。

lines.en: The power of [niece]s, I guess.
lines.zh: 大概就是[niece]的力量吧。

lines.en: scene black
: I guess I’m leaving now?...
lines.zh: : 那我这就走了？……

lines.en: : Yup! Can you meet us at the food court in like thirty minutes?
lines.zh: : 对！你能不能三十分钟后到美食广场找我们？

lines.en: : But what am I supposed to do until then? I came here with you guys.
lines.zh: : 可这中间我干什么？我是跟你们一起来的啊。

lines.en: : You’ll find something~
lines.zh: : 你会找到事做的~

lines.en: : Sensei! Could you bring me back something from the Chinese place, pleeeeease? I forgot to pack something for lunch sooo...thank you~
lines.zh: : Sensei！你能不能帮我带点那家中餐馆的东西回来，求求你了~？我忘了带午饭了，所以……谢谢啦~

lines.en: : Why does everyone always expect me to buy them things?
lines.zh: : 为什么所有人都指望我给他们买东西？

lines.en: : Sensei! If you’re buying us things, can you stop at Asteriskbucks and get me an iced coffee?
lines.zh: : Sensei！既然你要给我们买东西，能不能顺便去 Asteriskbucks 给我买杯冰咖啡？

lines.en: : Thank you and I love you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢，我爱你！

lines.en: : No, Ayane. You’re rich. Buy your own coffee.
lines.zh: : 不行，Ayane。你有钱。自己买咖啡。

lines.en: : I’ll get one for Sana, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我会给 Sana 买一杯。

lines.en: : W-What? But I...don’t even like...coffee...
lines.zh: : 什——什么？可是我……根本不……喜欢咖啡……

lines.en: scene halloweenmall12
I don’t make it more than two minutes away from Chika’s boutique before bumping into two more familiar faces.
lines.zh: 从 Chika 的精品店出来还没走两分钟，我就又撞上了两张熟悉的面孔。

lines.en: They don’t appear to have any bags with them, so I come to the conclusion that there can only be one thing that brought them here today.
lines.zh: 她们手上似乎没拿任何袋子，于是我得出结论：今天把她们带到这儿来的，只可能有一个原因。

lines.en: : Why are you two spying on me?
lines.zh: : 你们两个为什么跟踪我？

lines.en: : ...What?
: Oh. Never mind.
lines.zh: : 哦。当我没说。

lines.en: : I just didn’t see any bags.
lines.zh: : 我只是没看到你们拿袋子。

lines.en: : So...you decided we were spying on you?
lines.zh: : 所以……你就断定我们是在跟踪你？

lines.en: : It was Haru-chan’s idea. I told her it was a bad one, but she wouldn’t listen.
lines.zh: : 是 Haru-chan 的主意。我跟她说了这主意很糟，可她就是不听。

lines.en: : In fact, she’s been bullying me all morning. Please come save me, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 事实上，她欺负了我一整个早上。快来救我，Sensei~

lines.en: scene halloweenmall13
: You’re a really bad actor. You know that?
lines.zh: : 你演技真的很差。你知道吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but I’m cute so I can get away with it.
lines.zh: : 知道，但我可爱，所以没关系。

lines.en: : So, if you two aren’t here spying on me, what are you up to exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果你们不是来跟踪我的，那你们到底在干什么？

lines.en: scene halloweenmall14
: Halloween shopping!
lines.zh: : 万圣节采购！

lines.en: : We’re going to buy sexy outfits and get drunk at my place tonight.
lines.zh: : 我们要买性感的衣服，然后今晚在我家喝个烂醉。

lines.en: : That just sounds like a normal night but with sexy outfits added into the mixture.
lines.zh: : 这听起来就是个普通的夜晚，只不过往里面加了性感的衣服。

lines.en: : I know. Great, right?
lines.zh: : 我知道。很棒吧？

lines.en: scene halloweenmall14
: I’m going to make myself feel good by dressing as one of those sexy nurses you always see around Halloween and Haru-chan is...
lines.zh: : 我要扮成万圣节前后到处都能见到的那种性感护士，让自己心情大好，而 Haru-chan 要扮……

lines.en: : Doing something with Maki? What was it again? A cat?
lines.zh: : 跟 Maki 的那个有关？是什么来着？猫？

lines.en: scene halloweenmall15
: Nyaa~
scene halloweenmall16
: I can’t believe I just did that in public. Please kill me.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己刚在公共场合做了那种事。拜托杀了我吧。

lines.en: : Do it again, do it again!
lines.zh: : 再来一次，再来一次！

lines.en: : Yes, please do it again.
lines.zh: : 对，请再来一次。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall17
: I’ll do it plenty more times if you come hang out with us tonight!
lines.zh: : 如果你今晚来陪我们，我就多来几次！

lines.en: : I was beginning to worry that you two weren’t going to ask me.
lines.zh: : 我还在担心你们两个不会叫上我呢。

lines.en: : Of course we were going to ask you. We were actually just talking about you before you showed up.
lines.zh: : 我们当然会叫你。你出现之前我们还正在聊你呢。

lines.en: : Good things, I hope?
lines.zh: : 希望是好话？

lines.en: : Are there any bad ones?
lines.zh: : 有坏话吗？

lines.en: : Oh yeah. Tons.
lines.zh: : 哦，有。一大堆。

lines.en: : For starters, I’m here with your daughter right now.
lines.zh: : 首先，我现在是和你女儿一起来的。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall18
: Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : That sounded worse than I wanted it to.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来比我想说的更糟。

lines.en: : What...are you two doing? Where is she?
lines.zh: : 你们两个……在干什么？她在哪儿？

lines.en: : Costume shopping with my [niece] and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 陪我[niece]和 Ayane 买装扮。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall19
: Oh.
: Well...I guess it makes sense why you’re walking around by yourself then, at least.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少这样一来，你一个人在逛就说得通了。

lines.en: : But that’s just one more reason you should come to my place tonight.
lines.zh: : 但这也只是又一个你今晚该来我家的理由。

lines.en: : She’s got a point. Don’t you spend like, every waking moment surrounded by [teenage]girls?
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理。你醒着的每一刻不都被[teenage]女孩包围着吗？

lines.en: : I see no problem with this.
lines.zh: : 我看不出这有什么问题。

lines.en: : Well it’s just like...don’t you want to hang out with people your own age every once in a while?
lines.zh: : 就是……你偶尔难道不想和同龄人待在一起吗？

lines.en: Well...it’s true that people my age are less loud but-
lines.zh: 嗯……同龄人确实没那么吵，不过——

lines.en: Wait a minute. That isn’t true at all.
lines.zh: 等等。这根本不成立。

lines.en: Sara and Haruka are two of the loudest people I know when they get drunk.
lines.zh: Sara 和 Haruka 喝醉之后，可是我认识的人里最吵的两个。

lines.en: But...two drunk women in the same room...with a third in Maki...
lines.zh: 不过……两个喝醉的女人待在同一个房间里……再加上 Maki 这第三个……

lines.en: : Yeah. Count me in.
lines.zh: : 好啊。算我一个。

lines.en: : I don’t think the girls’ Halloween party is until tomorrow night, so I should be free.
lines.zh: : 女生们的万圣节派对应该是明天晚上，所以我今晚应该有空。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall20
: You’re even going to their Halloween party?
lines.zh: : 你连她们的万圣节派对都要去？

lines.en: : I’m the guest of honor. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我是主宾。大概吧。

lines.en: : You can be the guest of honor at the bar, too!
lines.zh: : 你也可以当酒吧的主宾啊！

lines.en: : You’ll be the only boy, so it makes sense.
lines.zh: : 你会是唯一的男人，所以很合理。

lines.en: : Now there’s just the issue of finding a temporary bartender since I don’t want Sana hanging around three horny drunk women all night.
lines.zh: : 现在只剩一个问题：得找个临时的调酒师，因为我可不想让 Sana 整晚都待在三个发情的醉鬼女人身边。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see you’re wearing your mom-hat today.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你今天戴上了妈妈这顶帽子。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall21
: Okay then. I guess we’re going to ignore the fact that she just called all of us horny.
lines.zh: : 好吧。看来我们要装作没听见她刚刚说我们都是发情狂这件事了。

lines.en: : This is fine.
lines.zh: : 这没关系。

lines.en: : Why can’t you just tend the bar, Sara?
lines.zh: : Sara，你自己调酒不行吗？

lines.en: scene halloweenmall22
: I want to get drunk and eat candy and feel pretty and sit on your lap!
lines.zh: : 我想喝醉、想吃糖、想觉得自己美美的，还想坐在你大腿上！

lines.en: : If you sit on my lap, won’t the other two girls get jealous?
lines.zh: : 你坐我大腿上，另外两个女孩不会吃醋吗？

lines.en: : Do they not realize I’m still here? Should I clap or something?
lines.zh: : 她们是不是没意识到我还在这儿？我要不要鼓个掌什么的？

lines.en: scene halloweenmall23
: So what if they get jealous? I’ll be Nurse Sara tonight. Sitting on your lap is the only way to cure your chronic illness.
lines.zh: : 吃醋又怎样？今晚我是护士 Sara。坐在你大腿上是治好你慢性病的唯一方法。

lines.en: : You would not have lasted very long in medical[school].
lines.zh: : 你要是去读医学[school]，肯定撑不了多久。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall24
: Okay, I’m gonna just step in and say it’s not really the best idea to start talking about sitting on his lap when your daughter could show up at any moment.
lines.zh: : 好了，我得插一句：你女儿随时可能出现，这时候开始聊坐在他大腿上真的不是什么好主意。

lines.en: : Oooh? Sounds to me like someone is jealous.
lines.zh: : 哦哦？听起来有人吃醋了呢。

lines.en: : Do you want to sit on his lap too, Haru-chan?
lines.zh: : Haru-chan，你也想坐他大腿吗？

lines.en: if harukafirstlust == True:
scene halloweenmall25
: Uhhh...
Oh, she’s done a lot more than just sit on my lap, Sara.
lines.zh: 哦，她做的事可远不止坐我大腿，Sara。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall25
: Even if I did, it’s not like I’d say anything about it in public.
lines.zh: : 就算我想，我也不可能在大庭广众下说出来啊。

lines.en: : Aww, come on~ You can be his little lap-cat and cuddle up really close.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，来嘛~ 你可以当他的小膝上猫，紧紧地贴着他。

lines.en: : I bet you purr really loudly...don’t you, kitty?
lines.zh: : 我敢说你呼噜打得特别响……对吧，小猫咪？

lines.en: scene halloweenmall26
: Okay, time to go.
lines.zh: : 好了，该走了。

lines.en: : I have to go take over a shift at the cafe soon anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我也快得去咖啡馆接班了。

lines.en: scene halloweenmall27
: Boo~ Haru-chan is making me say goodbye early.
lines.zh: : 嘘~ Haru-chan 非要我提前说再见。

lines.en: : You’ll come tonight, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过你今晚会来的。对吧？

lines.en: : Nurse Sara will be really sad if you don’t.
lines.zh: : 你不来的话，护士 Sara 会非常伤心的。

lines.en: : Oh, he’ll come alright.
lines.zh: : 哦，他会来的。

lines.en: : I really didn’t want that to sound sexual and I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我真不是故意让那句话听起来那么色的，对不起。

lines.en: : Can you keep an eye out for a spare bartender for us, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你能帮我们留意一下有没有多余的调酒师吗？

lines.en: : I’ll do it if I reaaaaaaally need to, but I wanna relaaaaaax.
lines.zh: : 实在实在没办法的话我自己来也行，但我真的想放放放放松。

lines.en: Sara begins to sound like a kid on the verge of a temper-tantrum.
lines.zh: Sara 开始听起来像个快要撒泼耍赖的小孩了。

lines.en: She does work almost every night. And even if she’s doing virtually nothing for most of those shifts, it would probably still be good for her to get some rest.
lines.zh: 她确实几乎每晚都在上班。而且就算那些班次里她基本什么都不用干，能休息一下对她大概也是好的。

lines.en: : I’ll keep an eye out, but I only know like...two and a half bartenders.
lines.zh: : 我会留意的，不过我认识的调酒师……大概只有两个半。

lines.en: : How do you know half of a bartender?
lines.zh: : 半个调酒师是怎么回事？

lines.en: : The third one isn’t really...all-there.
lines.zh: : 第三个不太……完整。

lines.en: : ...Okay, well we’re gonna go.
lines.zh: : ……好吧，那我们先走了。

lines.en: : Right. See you later.
lines.zh: : 好。回头见。

lines.en: : Bye, Sensei. I’ll miss you~
lines.zh: : 拜拜，Sensei。我会想你的~

lines.en: scene black
I continue to walk aimlessly around the mall for another few minutes before heading to the food court to meet up with the girls.
lines.zh: 我又漫无目的地在商场里逛了几分钟，然后才去美食广场和女孩们会合。

lines.en: They all eat lunch while I sit there and ponder over exactly what’s going to happen tonight.
lines.zh: 她们吃着午饭，我则坐在那里琢磨今晚到底会发生什么。

lines.en: And, of course, I forget to buy Chika’s...
lines.zh: 而我当然也忘了给 Chika 买……

lines.en: Wait, what was it she wanted again?
lines.zh: 等等，她到底要来着？
